verdict.rationale: Flagsmith ships a documented MCP server giving AI agents programmatic access to the Admin API (which can do 'anything the dashboard can do'), and a separate Experimentation feature with a Bayesian stats engine for reading A/B test results, so the building blocks for an agent to read configs and results exist. However, there's no direct evidence that experiment results/stats-engine output are specifically exposed through the Admin API or MCP surface, nor any documented workflow for an agent to fetch and summarize experiment outcomes for ship/rollback decisions. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoints for experiment results retrieval, and any documented agent-driven summarization/recommendation workflow.
